review_rule: Describe the documented integration or partner workflow and its selected deployment route.
Use GA, Beta, Early Access or Limited Availability only when the relevant current source explicitly supports the label.

If a specific subroute needs Adobe Customer Care enablement or enrollment, keep that condition on that subroute. Do not replace it with a universal gate, or remove it merely because other routes are documented.

Keep metadata cleanup priority separate from an existing medium citation-support finding.
